prediction.reasoning: The content describes CURL (Contrastive Unsupervised Reinforcement Learning) by Laskin et al. 2020, which learns spatial features using augmentation functions and InfoNCE loss. I searched the repository and found: (1) src/trainers/curl.py containing the CURLTrainer implementation, (2) src/common/augmentation.py containing augmentation functions, and (3) src/common/losses.py containing the CURLLoss. The key implementation is in curl.py where augmentation is applied (lines 59-65) to create two views (x_q and x_k), features are extracted through backbone and neck networks (lines 67-77), and InfoNCE loss is computed using cross-entropy on the similarity matrix (lines 89-96). This matches the paper's description of learning spatial features through contrastive learning with augmented views. The InfoNCE loss is implemented as a cross-entropy loss over the similarity matrix between query and key representations, which is the standard formulation of InfoNCE.
